title: SDK Integrations Launch — canary samples, telemetry hooks, structured-output validators
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a cross-functional launch for the SDK + API surface that ships function-calling, structured-output validation, and streaming examples. Deliverables: release notes template, localized sample kits (TS/Go/Python), canary telemetry hooks + dashboard, CI schema tests for structured output, and a staged rollout runbook with rollback and escalation paths for Hosted and Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published and signed off by Docs and Legal
Canonical samples repo updated with end-to-end streaming and function-calling examples in TypeScript, Go, and Python
Telemetry events instrumented for canary and GA with a monitoring dashboard tracking latency, error rate, sample-execution success, and schema-regression rate
Structured-output validator (JSON Schema + deterministic examples) integrated into CI and included in sample tests
Rollback and canary escalation runbook tested in a dry-run with SEs and SREs
